service.description:
The shell counts of a user: the service named by STRT_SHELL_COUNTS_SERVICE in the user's theme for STT_INTERNAL_QUASAR (found as a render finds it: the user's, a group's, the type's enumCode, a DEFAULT theme of the type; DEFAULT_QUASAR when there is none) is called with userId and its counts map returned. counts is null when the theme has no such value, and when the service is missing, fails or answers no map, which is logged once per service name. Another user's counts only with authorization disabled (internal work).
The counts service takes userId and answers counts, a map the shell reads by key: today, chat, email (external mail unread), messages (internal messages and the mailbox posts delivered to the Inbox), notifications (unviewed in the NinNotifications inbox and approvals waiting), approvals and updates (unviewed in NinUpdates, which no header badge shows), each a number or a map with a total; the framework sends it as it is.

Send each user their shell counts (get#ShellCounts) as a NotificationMessage on the topic shellCounts: not persisted, showAlert false, the counts as its message. Coalesced per user: at most one send every 2 seconds, and the requests inside that window fold into one send at its end. Inside a transaction the request waits for the commit (a rollback sends nothing), and the sends are made on a thread of the server, so the caller never waits for the counts. The EECAs and SECAs on the records the counts read call this.

parameter.name: userIdList
parameter.description: A list of userId, or a comma separated text
